highlights.excerpt:
User funds are safe!

It does look like a hack on Binance. Appreciate the quick freeze from Tether (~$971m) and Circle (~$823m).

I don't manage Binance (.com) anymore, but as a shareholder, I expect all user funds will be fully covered. https://t.co/oufpyNChxI
highlights.excerpt_zh:
用户资金是安全的！

看起来确实像是币安遭遇黑客攻击。感谢 Tether（约 9.71 亿美元）和 Circle（约 8.23 亿美元）迅速冻结。

我已不再管理 Binance（.com），但作为股东，我预计所有用户资金都会得到全额保障。
highlights.name: CZ 🔶 BNB
highlights.text_zh: CZ：币安疑似被黑，用户资金安全；Tether/Circle 已冻结约 18 亿。

highlights.excerpt:
There’s 100% a kind of mania you can get into with coding agents, where it feels like you’re getting a lot done and working all the time but nothing is really happening.

I think it's often a form of avoidance of something else in life.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
用编程智能体时，100% 会陷入一种狂热：感觉自己干了很多、一直在工作，其实什么都没真正发生。

我觉得这常常是在回避生活里的别的事。
highlights.name: Thariq
highlights.text_zh: Thariq：编程智能体易陷入假勤奋——感觉一直在干，其实没进展。

highlights.excerpt:
Anthropic will make ~1,000 employees worth +$100m at $2 trillion market cap.

There's ~11,000 Americans with $100m in investable assets. 

So something like 1 in 12 Americans with $100m (liquid) will be from Anthropic. If you add in Openai, maybe 1 in 7.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
若市值达到 2 万亿美元，Anthropic 将让约 1000 名员工身家超过 1 亿美元。

美国约有 1.1 万名拥有 1 亿美元可投资资产的人。

也就是说，大约每 12 个身家过亿（流动）的美国人里就有 1 个来自 Anthropic。再加上 OpenAI，也许是每 7 个里有 1 个。
highlights.name: Sam Parr
highlights.text_zh: 若 Anthropic 市值 2 万亿，约 1000 名员工身家将超 1 亿美元。
